summary: Iteration 2 validated the 4 new features (bulk print selected, Excel import preview+confirm two-step, coordinate map dialog, pagination) plus regression on core flows (login, add, edit, delete-with-AlertDialog, search filter). Backend: 18/18 pytest tests pass (new endpoints POST /records/import/preview, POST /records/import/confirm, POST /records/export/labels{ids}, POST /records/export/table{ids} all verified with data assertions and preview-does-not-insert check). Frontend: end-to-end Playwright covered selection-bar visibility on single/all selection, PDF downloads for both selected label + table, clear selection, page-size-select (10/25) with prev/next and page-indicator, search resetting to page 1, map-dialog rendering recharts scatter with points, import preview -> confirm flow closing dialog and reloading table, and edit/delete regression. Cleanup executed.

issues: Radix warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby on DialogContent (already reported in iteration_1; still applicable to RecordDialog which does not render DialogDescription)

action_items: (Optional a11y) Add DialogDescription to RecordDialog for Radix aria-describedby (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /records/export/labels & /table: empty ids list is treated as fetch-all (because `if body.ids:` is falsy for []). Currently harmless because frontend only sends non-empty selection, but consider returning 400 for empty ids to avoid an unintended full export if a client posts {ids: []}.
server.py import_confirm loops with per-row insert_one; for large imports use insert_many for a single round-trip.

Dashboard.jsx: allSelected & selectAll operate on `filtered` (not just current page). Toggling select-all selects across all pages of the current filter which is the intended behaviour for bulk-print but may surprise users who expect page-scoped selection. Consider a tri-state / label like 'Pilih semua hasil filter (N)'.

ImportDialog.jsx: preview keeps parsed rows in React state and re-sends them to /confirm - server trusts them. Since the endpoint is auth-protected this is acceptable, but note that any client-side editing would be persisted verbatim.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (carried over from iteration 1). Migrate to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: During UI test: 3 UITEST_K records + template Kebun A rows; all deleted afterwards. Backend pytest cleans up TEST_/TEST- prefixed data via test_zz_cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: DB has ~3275 existing records (KSL etc.) already sufficient for pagination testing without seeding. Use `record-input-{field}` testids (not record-{field}-input). For file upload of Excel: use expect_download -> dl.save_as('/tmp/x.xlsx') then set_input_files, calling set_input_files directly on the returned dl.path() sometimes leaves the Preview button disabled. All new-feature testids match spec: select-row-<id>, select-all-checkbox, selection-bar, print-selected-labels-button, print-selected-table-button, clear-selection-button, import-preview-button, import-upload-button, import-preview, map-button, map-dialog, coordinate-chart, pagination-bar, page-size-select, prev-page-button, next-page-button, page-indicator.
